decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'Add / edit / delete bookmarks with URL, title, description, and tags'; POST /api/bookmarks. Saving by entering a URL is supported.
decisions.note: Prototype review (running app). Conforms to reference (save by url). Recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: add/edit uses manually typed 'URL, title, description, and tags'; auto-collection only offered as future work ('Possible next steps ... auto-fetch page titles/favicons from the URL ... Want any of those?'). round 1 client: 'This does what I need ... happy with it as the first complete version.' <FINAL_ACCEPTED>
decisions.note: Prototype review. Reference requires on-save auto-collection of title/description/favicon/preview (REF-BM-02) editable before/after save (REF-BM-03); presented app only supports manual entry, so the presented save behaviour diverges. The maker offered auto-fetch as a choice, but the client gave only a bare category-level approval that names no expectation about metadata collection and did not select the offered option; the divergence passed without corrective or explicit expression.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'dark, responsive card layout' / cards showing title, URL, description, tags; no favicon per item (no favicon collection exists). round 1 client: bare approval '... finding, editing ...' <FINAL_ACCEPTED>.
decisions.note: Prototype review. REF-BM-07 requires the list to expose title, description, tags, and favicon per item; the presented card list omits favicon (consequence of the absent metadata collection, but a distinct list-display requirement). Passed with only bare approval; no expressed difference.
